1.w: Hallelu YAH! Praise the name of YHWH! Give praise, O servants of YHWH

2.w: who are standing in the house of YHWH, in the courts of the house of our God!

3.w: Praise YAH, for YHWH [is] good; sing praises to His name, for [it is] pleasant!

4.w: For YAH has chosen Jacob for Himself, Israel for His possession.

5.w: For I know that YHWH [is] great, and our Lord is greater than all gods!

6.w: All that YHWH delights in, He does, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all the depths,

7.w: bringing up the clouds from the ends of the earth. He has made lightning for the rain, bringing forth the wind from His storehouses—

8.w: who struck the firstborn of Egypt, from man even to beast.

9.w: He sent forth signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, unto Pharaoh and all of his servants—

10.w: who struck many nations and killed mighty kings,

11.w: even Sihon king of the Amorite, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan.

12.w: And He gave their land [as] an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel His people.

13.w: O YHWH, Your name [is] forever; YHWH, Your memorial [is] to generation and generation!

14.w: For YHWH will vindicate His people, and He will have compassion on His servants.

15.w: The idols of the nations [are] silver and gold, the work of the hands of man.

16.w: Mouths [are] unto them, and they do not speak; eyes [are] unto them, and they do not see.

17.w: Ears [are] unto them and they do not hear; indeed, there [is] no breath in their mouths.

18.w: Their makers shall come to be like them—everyone who is trusting in them!

19.w: O House of Israel, bless YHWH; O house of Aaron, bless YHWH;

20.w: O house of Levi, bless YHWH; [all you] fearing YHWH, bless YHWH!

21.w: Blessed be YHWH from Zion, the One dwelling [in] Jerusalem! Praise YAH!
